ouVivre.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same in both cases. Together, you each answer separately and the quiz looks for the place that would suit your couple best.
ouVivre.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
ouVivre.modeDuoMeta: Your place as a couple and where you disagree
ouVivre.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
ouVivre.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
ouVivre.setupTitreDuo: Where will you be living in 10 years?
ouVivre.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then passes the phone. At the end, you'll see the place where your couple could live and the questions where you don't agree.
ouVivre.setupTitreSolo: Where will you be living in 10 years?
ouVivre.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about the life you want in 10 years, for example about the weather or the neighbours. Answer with your couple in mind and you'll see which place would suit you best.
ouVivre.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
ouVivre.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
ouVivre.chacunMeme: On your own, you would each have picked the same place. Now you just have to go!
ouVivre.chacunGagne: Your place as a couple is {{nom}}'s pick. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
ouVivre.chacunCompromis: Your place as a couple isn't the one either of you picked alone. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
ouVivre.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
ouVivre.accordHaut: You picture more or less the same life.
ouVivre.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but there are two or three points left to talk about.
ouVivre.accordBas: You don't picture the same life at all. Talk it over before you start looking at listings!
ouVivre.jaugesTitre: The places that would suit you best
ouVivre.invitationDuo: And where does your partner see themselves in 10 years? Take the quiz again together to see which questions you disagree on.
ouVivre.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It gives you an idea but it doesn't know your job or your budget. The photos were created for this page.
ouVivre.p_montagne_d: You see yourselves in a mountain village, with snow in winter and trails that start at your door. You need fresh air and real seasons. At the weekend you'll be outdoors. In the evening you'll be by the wood stove.
ouVivre.p_montagne_a: The mountains aren't the same in February and in November. Rent a place there for a month in the off season before you decide. Check where the jobs and the school are too.
ouVivre.p_campagne_d: You see yourselves in the middle of the fields, with a dirt track and the nearest neighbour at the end of the meadow. You want space and quiet. You've had enough of traffic jams and you'd rather have a vegetable garden than a café terrace.
ouVivre.p_campagne_a: In the countryside you drive almost everywhere and friends no longer drop by on a whim. Work out your everyday journeys before you decide. Keep a spare room for the people who come to see you.
ouVivre.p_mer_d: You see yourselves near a harbour or a beach, with the smell of the sea when you open the shutters. You need to see the water and the horizon. You'll walk on the beach even in winter, when nobody else is there.
ouVivre.p_mer_a: The seaside isn't the same in August and in January, when half the shutters are closed. Go there in the off season before you decide. Look at the prices too, because a nice view is expensive.
ouVivre.p_metropole_d: You see yourselves in a big city, with lights, noise and lots of things to do ten minutes from home. You like restaurants, exhibitions and meeting new people. You have no wish to take the car to buy bread.
ouVivre.p_metropole_a: A big city is expensive and it wears you out. Pick a neighbourhood where you can do everything on foot, with a park not too far away. Plan a weekend in the country from time to time too.
ouVivre.p_petiteVille_d: You see yourselves in a small town, with a square, a Saturday market and shopkeepers who know you. You want to do everything on foot without living in the noise. You'll always bump into someone on the way to buy bread!
ouVivre.p_petiteVille_a: Check that there's work for each of you or a train station not too far away. A small town is perfect as long as neither of you gets bored there.
ouVivre.p_banlieue_d: You see yourselves on a quiet street with a garden, half an hour from a big city. You want room to live and you also want to enjoy the city. Lots of couples make this choice and it suits them very well.
ouVivre.p_banlieue_a: It all comes down to the commute. Do the journey at rush hour before you sign. Check what there is to do nearby on a Sunday too.
ouVivre.p_etranger_d: You see yourselves in another country, with another language and other habits. You like starting from scratch and the idea of beginning again somewhere else excites you more than it worries you. In 10 years you may already have changed countries twice!
ouVivre.p_etranger_a: When you move abroad, you also move away from your family and friends. Tell each other how long you're leaving for. Leaving for two years and leaving for good are not the same plan.
ouVivre.p_ile_d: You see yourselves on an island, with water all around and sunshine almost all year. You dream of a slower life, in a place where everyone knows each other and the sea is five minutes away. You'll go back to the mainland for the holidays.
ouVivre.p_ile_a: On an island, everything arrives by boat or by plane, including parcels and friends. Spend a whole season there before you sell your furniture.
ouVivre.p_lac_t: By a lake, in the middle of nature
ouVivre.p_lac_d: You see yourselves in a wooden house by a lake, with the forest behind you and not a sound. You're looking for peace and an evening with no signal doesn't scare you. Your friends will have a long drive to come and see you.
ouVivre.p_lac_a: Living far from everything works well when each of you has chosen it. If one of you needs to see people, keep a foot in town or at least a good internet connection.
ouVivre.p_ici_d: You don't need to look any further because you're happy right where you are. Your family and friends are nearby and you have your habits. In 10 years you may have changed homes but you'll still be in the same area.
ouVivre.p_ici_a: Staying in the same place doesn't stop you from moving around a little. You could go on a long trip or spend a year somewhere else, for example. It feels good to come back home!
ouVivre.q1: In the morning, you want to hear:
ouVivre.q2a: A hike or a day of skiing
ouVivre.q2c: An exhibition and a good restaurant
ouVivre.q3a: Less than twenty minutes away, that matters to us
ouVivre.q3b: An hour or two away by car
ouVivre.q3c: Far away, we'll see them in the holidays
ouVivre.q3d: Very far away, we'll video call
ouVivre.q4a: In an office in the city
ouVivre.q4c: A local job, close to home
ouVivre.q4d: As little as possible if we can
ouVivre.q5c: Wind and a sky that keeps changing
ouVivre.q5d: It doesn't matter, we mostly live indoors
ouVivre.q7a: Lots of them and we know them all
ouVivre.q7b: A few, on the other side of the hedge
ouVivre.q7d: Thousands and we don't know any of them
ouVivre.q8: From the living room window, you see:
ouVivre.q9b: Why not, for a few years
ouVivre.q9c: A few words for the holidays
ouVivre.q9d: No thanks, we're very happy here
ouVivre.q10: On Sunday evening, you feel good when:
ouVivre.q10a: Everything is quiet and you can hear the rain
ouVivre.q10b: There's still life in the street below
ouVivre.q10c: You're back from a walk by the water
ouVivre.q10d: You've seen your family or friends during the day
ouVivre.q11a: We love it, we've done it several times
ouVivre.q11b: Just once, for the right place
ouVivre.q12: In 10 years, what will matter most:
ouVivre.q12d: Having kept your loved ones and your habits close
